context: General associative-ring convention; ring identity optional. Reduced does not imply integral domain.
editorial_note: General associative-ring convention; ring identity optional. Reduced does not imply integral domain.
text: An associative ring R is reduced if every nilpotent element is zero: if r∈R and r^n=0 for some positive integer n, then r=0.
